headline: OpenAI closes the Sora consumer app as planned
body: A quiet day. OpenAI shut down the consumer Sora video app, as it had announced in March, to focus on business tools; the API is due to follow in September. A product being pulled is a faint signal of Tech Backlash, so Reversion moved by a hair. Horizon Balance reads +1.97.
movers_note: Only small moves today: Reversion +0.06, from OpenAI shutting Sora (+0.04) and fading earlier news (+0.01); Enslaved God -0.02, from fading earlier news (-0.02).
coming_up: Sora API scheduled to shut down in September
